landmark_annotation.coordinate_space: Original native1254x1254 PNG, x right and y down; no cropping/scaling/packing performed.
landmark_annotation.method: Manual visual annotation of face center, hand grip, top tip of glowing central violet crystal, visible hair top excluding hat, and mean of two sole-contact center points. Pillow/numpy used only read-measure alpha and connected components. Error bounds are estimates, not calibrated certainty.
landmark_annotation.foot_definition: Arithmetic mean of TWO boot sole-contact centers; rear sole obscured by skirt explicitly estimated.
landmark_annotation.hair_definition: Visible top of chestnut hair below brim; hat and staff excluded. Occluded hair/sole locations are visual estimates.
landmark_annotation.muzzle_definition: Top visible tip of glowing central violet staff crystal, excluding silver crown point; manually estimated.
landmark_annotation.normalization: None. Runtime processor must use one fixed direction idle reference for all poses and preserve crouch height; do not enlarge each dash/guard pose to standing height.

visual_review.handedness: Anatomical left staff/right free command; guard two hands.

pending_checks: Built-in tool returned native1254square; native2K requirement not met, no upscale applied.
Some full silhouettes cross invisible cell bounds or have less than35px margin. Four characters are separate connected components but rectangular bboxes can contain neighbor pixels.

Runtime processor must separate connected components with manual head/foot/grip seeds, retain same-body staff/hat detail and clean only measured low-alpha external noise under user-authorized local frame processing.
Direction-wide fixed idle scale/anchor review and complete12-direction family review required before production.
notes: Original raw output copied without software editing. Wrong-direction and multi-arm rejected intermediates remain only CODEX generated_images. No portrait, previous basic source, loader, manifest, tools code, Godot execution, or commit changed.
processing: Existing independent alpha8 components; alpha<8/hidden RGB cleared, sole anchors aligned by integer translation. No redraw, rotation, mirroring, pixel resizing or pose fitting.
